JTAPS Winterland Bar: Step Into the Season

February 9, 2026 JTAPS Team Seasonal

Your Winterland Bar in Cincinnati

This season, JTAPS Bar and Grill transforms into a Winterland Bar with warm lighting, festive decor, and the same game day energy you love. If you are looking for a cozy spot to catch the game, meet friends, or unwind after work, our Winterland theme makes every visit feel like a night out.

Stop In Today for Your Favorites

Winter vibes pair perfectly with our JTAPS favorites. Order famous Pete's Sauce wings, hand-carved gyros, juicy burgers, and ice-cold drinks while you watch the action on 50+ TVs. Whether you come for lunch, dinner, or a big game, the Winterland atmosphere makes it even better.

  • Wings: Classic, crispy, and sauced just right
  • Gyros: Hand-carved and loaded with flavor
  • Burgers: Juicy, stacked, and made to order
  • Drinks: Cold beers, bourbon, and seasonal pours
